name: D9
description: D9, known as Deenine, was a protocol droid spy and an associate of the self-made droid L3-37. At L3-37's request, he tracked down the Phylanx Redux Transmitter, a device created by the gangster Fyzen Gor that could control droids, forcing them to kill. D9 was captured by Gor, and was left mutilated in the gangster's workshop. L3-37, accompanied by the smuggler Lando Calrissian, followed a signal sent by D9, and learned of the Phylanx Redux Transmitter's nature. After meeting with L3-37, D9 malfunctioned due to damage sustained at the hands of Gor.
